name: Mirabelle
recommendation: A lovely bakery during the day and an excellent Italian restaurant in the evenings. A relaxed and casual place with outstanding food quality. Much of the food is made from local ingredients, with bread and soft cheese, such as mozzarella and burrata, made on-site. They offer cheese, charcuterie, pasta dishes and creatively constructed small veggie plates. Mirabelle is a sister restaurant to Bæst, both owned by Christian Puglisi. So if you want pizza, go next door!
